title: A Statistical-Finance Benchmark for Same-Day Directional Stock Prediction: Walk-Forward Evidence from SPY
abstract: arXiv:2608.26106v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study statistical predictability in daily U.S. equity prices using only information available at the market open. Using SPY from February 1, 1993 through March 15, 2024, we benchmark XGBoost against Random Forest, LightGBM, Logistic Regression, and naive baselines under expanding-window walk-forward validation. After observing the current day's opening price and two lagged target-specific prices, the task is to predict whether the same day's close will be above or below the previous day's close.   On the last 800 trading days, Logistic Regression attains the highest close-direction accuracy (71.09%), Random Forest reaches 61.20%, and XGBoost reaches 58.45% with a 95% bootstrap confidence interval of [54.94%, 62.08]. For XGBoost, close-direction accuracy rises to 72.7% when the predicted move exceeds 1%, but the usable sample falls to 154 observations. translated_title: 同日股票方向预测的统计金融基准：来自SPY的滚动前向证据
translated_abstract: 我们研究了仅使用市场开盘时可用信息对美国每日股票价格进行统计可预测性的问题。使用1993年2月1日至2024年3月15日的SPY数据，我们在扩展窗口滚动前向验证下，将XGBoost与随机森林、LightGBM、逻辑回归及朴素基线进行了基准比较。在观察当日开盘价和两个滞后目标特定价格后，任务是预测当日收盘价是否高于或低于前一日收盘价。在最后800个交易日中，逻辑回归实现了最高的收盘方向准确率（71.09%），随机森林达到61.20%，XGBoost达到58.45%，其95%自助置信区间为[54.94%, 62.08]。对于XGBoost，当预测波动超过1%时，收盘方向准确率上升至72.7%，但可用样本降至154个观测值。我们还报告了Diebold-Mariano和McNemar检验、分体制结果以及SHAP特征重要性。
tldr: 本研究通过SPY数据的滚动前向验证，发现逻辑回归在当日股票方向预测中表现最佳，准确率达71.09%，而XGBoost在预测大幅波动时准确率提升至72.7%，但样本量受限。
en_tdlr: This study, using walk-forward validation on SPY data, finds logistic regression achieves the highest same-day direction accuracy at 71.09%, while XGBoost improves to 72.7% for large predicted moves, albeit with limited sample size.
